title.from: Introduce GitBouncer branding and CLI with Pudicus compatibility
title.to: Make LeftBlock the canonical package and CLI with Pudicus compatibility

description.from: Local compatibility preparation is complete in a separate small review copy: GitBouncer alias package and CLI entry point, legacy Pudicus command/imports retained, distribution name still pudicus, and original configuration paths/secret path/receipt identifiers/rules preserved. Five compatibility tests pass, including offline wheel inspection using existing build tools. Actual hook runtime passed three runtime tests; packaging checks ran in the existing packaging environment. No dependency installation, metadata refresh, package publication or rename-source push occurred. External branding is paused for https://github.com/achrafash/gitbouncer overlap resolution; keep local work reviewable and preserve the working Pudicus integration. New bare launcher requires a reviewed metadata refresh after the decision.
description.to: The final canonical product and distribution name is LeftBlock; the old GitBouncer branding block is cleared. Implement and validate the new leftblock 0.3.0 package and command while retaining the required legacy Pudicus command/import compatibility, configuration filenames, secret path, hook runtime, receipt identifiers and rules. Preserve the existing pudicus project and releases. Prior local alias-prototype tests are evidence only for that prototype; rerun canonical wheel, runtime and installation checks for LeftBlock before release. The build is in progress and a new package upload is not yet verified.
